product_overview: A local e-commerce demo that lets visitors browse products, signed-in users simulate purchases, and authenticated users view order history. It also includes a simple admin interface for managing products in local state.
core_goals: Browse a catalog of physical products
View detailed information for a selected product
Log in with the demo account to unlock protected actions
Review past orders in order history
Add, edit, and delete products through an admin interface

features.name: Demo Login
features.description: Users can sign in with the hardcoded test account to access protected features.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Enter the demo email address -> Enter the demo password -> Submit the login form -> See the authenticated app state
Navigate to /login -> Enter invalid credentials -> Submit the login form -> See an error alert for invalid credentials

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Users can browse the product catalog and open product details from the landing page.
user_flows: Navigate to / -> Wait for products to load -> View product cards with images, categories, and prices -> Open a product's details page
Navigate to / -> Wait for products to load -> Attempt to purchase a product from the catalog -> See the purchase outcome notification

features.name: Product Details Viewing
features.description: Users can inspect a selected product's details and attempt to buy it when signed in.
user_flows: Navigate to /product/:id -> Wait for the product details to load -> Read the product description and price -> Buy the product when authenticated -> See the purchase outcome notification
Navigate to /product/:id -> Wait for the product details to load -> Attempt to open a product with an invalid id -> See an invalid product state

features.name: Protected Order History
features.description: Authenticated users can open the order history page and review previously recorded orders.
user_flows: Log in with the demo account -> Navigate to /orders -> Wait for orders to load -> Review prior order cards with date and price

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Authenticated users can manage products from a protected admin page.
user_flows: Log in with the demo account -> Navigate to /admin -> Fill out the product form -> Submit the new product -> Observe snackbar feedback
Log in with the demo account -> Navigate to /admin -> Select an existing product to edit -> Update the product details -> Save changes -> Observe snackbar feedback
Log in with the demo account -> Navigate to /admin -> Remove an existing product -> Observe snackbar feedback

features.name: Logout Flow
features.description: Authenticated users can end their session and return to the login page.
user_flows: Log in with the demo account -> Click logout from the top navigation -> Confirm redirect to /login -> Attempt to access a protected route again -> Return to the login page

routes.description: Product catalog landing page with product cards and buy buttons
Login page for the demo account
Product detail page for a selected product
Protected order history page showing mock past orders
Protected admin page for managing products in local UI state

features.name: Demo Login
features.description: Users can sign in with a hard-coded demo email and password stored in the frontend
user_interactions: Open the login page
Enter email address
Enter password
Click Login to authenticate
See an error alert for invalid credentials

features.name: Product Catalog Browsing
features.description: Users can browse a mock product catalog loaded from local mock data
user_interactions: Open the catalog page
Wait for products to load
View product cards with images, categories, and prices
Click View Details on a product
Attempt to click Buy from the catalog

features.name: Product Details Viewing
features.description: Users can view details for a selected mock product and attempt purchase from the detail page
user_interactions: Navigate to a product details page
Wait for the product details to load
Read the product description and price
Click Buy when authenticated
See an error state for an invalid product id

features.name: Protected Order History
features.description: Authenticated users can access a protected order history page backed by mock order data
user_interactions: Log in with the demo account
Open the Orders page from navigation
Wait for orders to load
Review prior order cards with date and price

features.name: Admin Product Management
features.description: Authenticated users can add, edit, and delete products in local component state
user_interactions: Log in with the demo account
Open the Admin page from navigation
Fill the product form and submit a new product
Edit an existing product and save changes
Delete an existing product
Observe snackbar feedback after each action

features.name: Logout Flow
features.description: Authenticated users can log out and are redirected to the login page
user_interactions: Log in with the demo account
Click Logout in the top navigation
Confirm redirect to the login page
Attempt to access protected routes again

known_limitations.issue: Authentication state is stored only in React state and resets on page refresh
known_limitations.impact: Users are logged out on reload and protected access is not persisted

known_limitations.issue: All product and order data is mock frontend data with no backend persistence
known_limitations.impact: Data changes are not saved across refreshes and no real API is exercised

known_limitations.issue: Purchase actions only show a success snackbar and do not create orders
known_limitations.impact: Buying a product does not update order history or persist a transaction

known_limitations.issue: Admin create, edit, and delete actions only modify local component state
known_limitations.impact: Admin changes disappear on refresh and do not affect the shared catalog
